name: Tokyo
tagline: Neon nights, cherry blossoms and ramen counters.
description: Tokyo from dawn to midnight: the Shibuya scramble, lantern-lit alleys, cherry blossom canals, Asakusa's temple gate, tiny ramen counters, Harajuku side streets, late-night corner stores and a day trip to Mount Fuji. Cinematic neon and soft spring pastels.
